articles.title: FBI Reveals How Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents to Gain Privileged Access in Under Three Hours
articles.summary:
The FBI has warned that hackers are using ARTEX AI agents to automate network attacks, with some intrusions reaching privileged access in under three hours. Its November 13, 2026, FLASH alert describes how attackers combine stolen credentials, exposed applications, and cloud permissions to shorten the gap between discovery and compromise. articles.title: Microsoft Warns of Active Password Stealing Attack Exploiting the Microsoft 365 Service Disruption
articles.summary:
Microsoft has warned of an active phishing campaign using the November 12 Microsoft 365 service disruption to lure users into opening fake email recovery links. The messages copy Microsoft service health notices and cite the real Exchange Online incident EX1550543, making the requests appear linked to an ongoing business problem. articles.title: Cursor Reveals How a Leaked Fireworks AI Key Led to a Backdoored Claude Code Extension
articles.summary:
Cursor has traced its October security breach to an access key exposed by Fireworks AI. The attacker used that key to steal historical coding agent records, find more credentials, and eventually place backdoored Claude Code extensions in Cursor’s marketplace cache.
